description.zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

* **true**：自动付费，默认值。
* **false**：手动付费。您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击**费用** > **续费管理**，然后单击左侧导航栏的**订单管理** > **我的订单**，找到目标订单进行支付。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: true. Valid values:

*   **true**: enables automatic payment.
*   **false**: disables automatic payment. If automatic payment is disabled, you must perform the following steps to complete the payment in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console: In the top navigation bar, choose **Expenses** > **Renewal Management**. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Orders**. On the **Orders** page, find the order and complete the payment.
The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.
The validity period of the bandwidth that you purchase. Unit: days. Valid values: **1**, **2**, **3**, **7**, **14**, **30**, **60**, **90**, **180**, **365**, **730**, **1095**, and **1825**.

description.zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入。
description.en: The source of the operation. This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh: 不再推荐使用本接口，您可以通过控制台（[调整实例带宽](~~102588~~)）或调用[EnableAdditionalBandwidth](~~473771~~)购买实例的带宽。
descriptions.en: You can adjust the bandwidth of an instance in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console. For more information, see [Adjust the bandwidth of an instance](~~102588~~). You can also call the [EnableAdditionalBandwidth](~~473771~~) operation to purchase bandwidth for an instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore renew-additional-bandwidth --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --coupon-no youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank --auto-pay true --order-time-length 30 --source-biz SDK --region cn-hangzhou
